
OpenClaw 2026.8.1 (ea80657) — All your chats, one OpenClaw.

Usage: openclaw plugins install [options] <path-or-spec-or-plugin>

Install a plugin or hook pack (path, archive, npm spec, git repo,
clawhub:package, or marketplace entry)

Arguments:
  path-or-spec-or-plugin                Path (.ts/.js/.zip/.tgz/.tar.gz), npm
                                        package spec, or marketplace plugin name

Options:
  --accept-capabilities                 Accept the plugin's declared
                                        capabilities (default: false)
  --acknowledge-install-policy-warning  Acknowledge security.installPolicy
                                        warnings without prompting; blocks and
                                        failures remain terminal (default:
                                        false)
  --dangerously-force-unsafe-install    Deprecated no-op; security.installPolicy
                                        may still block (default: false)
  --force                               Confirm non-ClawHub sources and
                                        overwrite an existing plugin or hook
                                        pack (default: false)
  -h, --help                            Display help for command
  -l, --link                            Link a local path instead of copying
                                        (default: false)
  --marketplace <source>                Install a Claude marketplace plugin from
                                        a local repo/path or git/GitHub source
  --pin                                 Record npm installs as exact resolved
                                        <name>@<version> (default: false)
